title: Blue Period
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yatora Yaguchi, a popular high-school student who excels without passion, is moved by a painting and decides to pursue art, aiming for the fiercely competitive Tokyo University of the Arts. The story follows his study, self-doubt and growth, alongside classmates including Yuka Ayukawa, who presents as feminine and struggles with family rejection (from general knowledge, to verify).
life_message: Holds up following a genuine passion through hard work, and being honest about who you are.
